missing_volume.definition: Identifiers with >50% of full-feed report rows missing volume

missing_rainfall.definition: Identifiers with >50% of full-feed report rows missing rainfall

negative_volume.definition: Report rows with converted volume below zero

negative_rainfall.definition: Report rows with rainfall below zero

implausible_rainfall.definition: Report rows with rainfall above 254 mm

implausible_volume.definition: Report rows with volume above 10 million US gallons

long_duration.definition: Report rows with duration above 72 hours

quarantined_from_fit.definition: Report rows excluded by any plausibility filter

unresolved_time.definition: Report rows with missing, malformed, conflicting or ambiguous clocks

note: Identifier missingness flags and report-row flags have separate units. Report-row flags overlap; their sum is not the unique excluded-row count. Missingness and unresolved clocks do not quarantine calendar-year analysis.
